subject: Skylumen exec intro & demo — VP/CIO presence windows
messages:
From: Amelia Ross <amelia.ross@skylumen.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@skylumen.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + demo request — Skylumen exec ask

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Our CIO (Raj Patel) and VP of Engineering (Lena Ortiz) will be evaluating inference vendors next month and we want a short, executive-facing demo focused on reliability, latency SLOs, and deployment options (esp. private/VPC).

Can you run a 35–40 minute session that includes 10 minutes of exec Q&A? Ideally we’d have the CIO and VP present for the first 25–30 minutes. Tom and I can handle the deeper technical follow-ups with your engineers.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue, Jun 22: 09:30–10:15 or 13:30–14:15
- Wed, Jun 23: 11:00–11:45

If those don’t work we can open the afternoon on Jun 24. We’ll need a short agenda and any high-level compliance notes (SOC2/retention) to share with procurement.

Best,
Amelia Ross
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Skylumen Systems
amelia.ross@skylumen.com
(415) 555-0182
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amelia Ross <amelia.ross@skylumen.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + demo request — Skylumen exec ask

Amelia — thanks for the details. Great to hear Raj and Lena can join. We can absolutely tailor a 40-minute executive session that covers: quick intro, high-level architecture (hosted/dedicated/private), measured latency examples, and an ops/SLAs slide. Then a 10-minute live Q&A.

From our side I can cover the product narrative and customer outcomes; Marissa will lead the architecture brief and Vivek can join for the SLA/fallbacks segment.

Available windows (PST) — we can do:
- Tue, Jun 22: 09:30–10:10 (tight)
- Tue, Jun 22: 13:30–14:15 (ideal)
- Wed, Jun 23: 11:00–11:45 (also works)

Can you confirm which of the three you prefer? If Raj needs a short pre-brief (5–10m) with our CTO before the demo we can add that immediately before the session.

I attached a draft agenda and a one-pager on SOC 2 + retention.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + demo request — Skylumen exec ask

Thanks — the team discussed and the VP prefers the Tue afternoon slot, but Raj (CIO) is tight. He can do Tue, Jun 22: 13:30–14:15 (he’ll drop at 14:00 if needed). That still works for you?

Also two asks from procurement:
1) Can you surface any existing enterprise customers in financial services (anonymized is OK) who use Redwood Private?
2) We’ll need a short statement on data retention defaults and the ability to customize retention windows.

Tom, can you confirm calendar invite once Ben confirms?

Perfect — we’re set for Tue, Jun 22, 13:30–14:15 PST with a soft stop at 14:00 for the CIO. I asked Marissa to trim the deep-dive to ensure the executive narrative is front-loaded. Vivek will cover SLA/fallbacks and draft a short anonymized reference statement we’ve used for financial services customers.

I’ve sent a calendar invite to Raj and Lena and copied Tom. Agenda attached (Skylumen-demo-agenda-v1.pdf). For procurement, I’m attaching our SOC2 summary paragraph and a short note about configurable retention windows; Marissa will follow up with a redline-ready compliance checklist if you need more.
